task.instructions:
Using matplotlib, draw a vertical violin plot comparing commute times (in minutes) across four modes of transport. The samples are:
  Bus:   28, 31, 33, 35, 38, 41, 45, 52, 60
  Bike:  18, 20, 21, 22, 24, 25, 27, 29, 33
  Car:   22, 24, 27, 30, 32, 35, 40, 48, 58
  Train: 30, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 38, 39, 41
Requirements:
1. One violin per mode at x positions 1, 2, 3, 4 in the order above, with the mode name as the x tick label.
2. Call violinplot with showmedians=True and keep the default extrema bars, so each violin shows its median and its min/max.
3. On top of the violins, plot each group's median as a single circular marker (marker='o', no connecting line) at (position, median). There must be exactly one such marker per group.
4. Give the chart a title and label both axes (the y axis is minutes).

function.arguments:
{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > plot.py
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Data
bus = [28, 31, 33, 35, 38, 41, 45, 52, 60]
bike = [18, 20, 21, 22, 24, 25, 27, 29, 33]
car = [22, 24, 27, 30, 32, 35, 40, 48, 58]
train = [30, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 38, 39, 41]

# X positions
x = [1, 2, 3, 4]
labels = ['Bus', 'Bike', 'Car', 'Train']

# Create figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))

# Create violin plot with showmedians=True
parts = ax.violinplot([bus, bike, car, train], positions=x, showmedians=True)

# Calculate medians for marker placement
medians = [np.median(bus), np.median(bike), np.median(car), np.median(train)]

# Plot median markers (circular, no connecting line)
ax.scatter(x, medians, marker='o', color='red', zorder=10, s=60)

# Set x-axis labels
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(labels)

# Set axis labels and title
ax.set_ylabel('Minutes')
ax.set_title('Commute Times by Mode of Transport')

# Save figure
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('figure.png')
print("Figure saved successfully to figure.png")
EOF
